name: com.rppg.tts
description: Plug-and-play neural Text-to-Speech for Unity. Ships with English (Piper Amy via Sherpa-onnx) and Japanese (Akagi Mitama via VOICEVOX). 100% offline, no internet calls. Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS. Architecture pluggable via ITTSProvider — easy to add more voices/languages.

samples.description: Standalone scene to test both English and Japanese voices via a dropdown and a button.
